title: stopRecord
description: Stop a recording started by an earlier `record` step. With no target (`true`/`null`), stops the most recently started recording that is still active (LIFO). To stop a specific recording when several overlap, target it by name with a string (`stopRecord: "<name>"`) or an object (`stopRecord: { name: "<name>" }`).

anyOf.title: stopRecord (boolean or null)
anyOf.description: If `true` or `null`, stops the most recently started active recording (LIFO). If `false`, does nothing — an explicit no-op (mirrors `record: false`).
anyOf.$comment: One branch for both types: with coerceTypes, Ajv turns null into false in a boolean-only branch, and false into null in a null-only branch.

anyOf.title: stopRecord (name)
anyOf.description: Name of the recording to stop. Matches the `name` given to a `record` step.

name.description: Name of the recording to stop. Matches the `name` given to a `record` step.
